args: Complete guided pilot: contact-map quality and H100 cost
caption: GPU model: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3. Each point averages the same planned structures. Guided curves use sum-q aggregation over increasing independent trajectories; ordinary curves show frequency, sum q and predicted-rollout-F1-weighted votes. The F1 rule is an exploratory addition after the ordinary-pool pilot. Search cost includes discarded proposals, lookahead, population branches, repair and final scoring. Ordinary frequency omits proofreader cost. GPU resource seconds sum the work for all trajectories; they are not parallel serving latency. Model staging and loading are excluded. These are measured compute envelopes, not exactly cost-matched experiments.
